question: Which of the following is NOT a National Waterway of the country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Waterway No.6**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Waterway No. 6 is a national waterway in India**.
 
• It is **built on the Barak River. **
 
• **The National Waterways Act **of 2016 declared 111 inland waterways as National Waterways. 
 
• The **Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI) is responsible for the development and maintenance of these waterwa**ys. 
 
• The National Waterways are an economical and environmentally friendly mode of transport. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Waterway 1**

 
 
• The **Ganga-Bhagirathi-Hooghly River System, **which runs from Prayagraj to Haldia.
 
• It is the l**ongest National Waterway in India. **
 
 
 
• **National Waterway 2**
 
 
• The** Brahmaputra River, which runs from Sadiya to Dhubri in Assam.**
 
• It is important for transporting goods and passengers in the North-Eastern region. 
 
 
 
• **National Waterway 3**
 
 
• The** West Coast Canal, which runs from Kottapuram to Kollam in Kerala**.
 
• It includes the Champakara and Udyogmandal canals. 
 
 
 
• **National Waterway 4**
 
 
• The** river Krishna, which runs from Muktiyala to Vijaywada in Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• It also runs along the Coromandal Coast and connects to the Godavari River.
